title: Keep cost boundaries comparable
method: Synthetic local total=18,000+12,000=30,000; cloud difference=4,000, or 13.3%. Replacement allocation answers long-run cost, not necessarily next-year cash flow.
alt: Keep cost boundaries comparable: Local operations 18000 currency units/year, Replacement allocation 12000 currency units/year, Cloud comparator 34000 currency units/year. Illustrative inputs.
